newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to announce CPMF tax details next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to announce CPMF tax details next week.

text.p: The Brazilian government will announce next week whether stock market investments will be subject to a new tax on financial transactions, a Finance Ministry spokesman said.
"The issue will only be resolved next week, and probably towards the end of it," the spokesman said.
Finance Minister Pedro Malan would begin studying on Friday the possibilty of exempting stock market investors from the CPMF, as the new tax is known by its Portuguese acronym.
The tax will levy a 0.2 percent charge on financial transactions from Janary 23 to raise about $400 million a month for Brazil's health service.

Officials have expressed concern the CPMF will turn investors off Brazil's stock markets. But others say exempting just stock market investors would prove difficult to manage and might lead to demands for similar treatment from other sectors.
On Thursday, the Central Bank said new quarterly savings accounts opened after the tax comes into effect would be exempt from the new tax.
